IGUI_B42SMA_KeyTip: While aiming with left-click blocking enabled, press once for one weapon floor attack. Keyboard, middle mouse or buttons 4-8; left/right mouse reserved. Initially unbound.
IGUI_B42SMA_BlockTip: Blocks automatic and manual left-click weapon floor attacks. Standing attacks and the separate shove/stomp control remain available. Assign the floor attack control first. While enabled, Vanilla's automatic target selection is on and locked.
